description: This file defines the ExternalIdConverter class, implementing JPA AttributeConverter to convert ExternalId objects to String for database storage and vice versa, utilizing ExternalIdFactory for object creation.

classes.name: ExternalIdConverter
classes.description: A JPA attribute converter for ExternalId objects to and from String representation.

methods.name: convertToDatabaseColumn
methods.description: Converts ExternalId object to its String representation for database storage.

methods.name: convertToEntityAttribute
methods.description: Converts a String from the database back into an ExternalId object.
